findings.description: The bucket is explicitly commented as public and has no ACL restricting access, no public access block, and no bucket policy denying public access, allowing unauthenticated access to the sensitive customer-master.xlsx object stored in it.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, meaning data stored in this bucket (including customer master data) is not encrypted at rest.

findings.issue_category: sensitive data exposed via public bucket
findings.description: This object containing customer master data is uploaded to the aws_s3_bucket.data bucket, which is public and unencrypted, exposing potentially sensitive customer information to unauthorized access and lacking encryption at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket holding financial data, leaving stored data unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, leaving stored operations data unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, leaving stored data science data unencrypted at rest.
